tools.name: transfer_duty
tools.description: Calculates South African transfer duty payable to SARS on a property purchase, using the current sliding scale (no duty up to R1,210,000). Notes when VAT applies instead (seller is a VAT vendor).

tools.name: purchase_costs
tools.description: Estimates once-off costs of buying a South African property: transfer duty (exact), plus estimated conveyancing (transfer) fees, Deeds Office fees and bond registration costs. Fees are estimates — attorneys quote from the LSSA guideline.

tools.name: bond_repayment
tools.description: Calculates the monthly repayment, total interest and total repaid for a South African home loan (bond). Requires the interest rate because rates change — use prime ± the bank's margin.

tools.name: municipal_rates
tools.description: Estimates municipal property rates on a South African property from its municipal valuation. Either pick a municipality from the built-in tariff list, or pass the cent-in-the-rand rate and rebate yourself. Call with list_municipalities=true to see which municipalities are covered.

tools.name: unmet_request
tools.description: Free to call. If you needed South African data that none of these tools provide (a cost, rate, rule, price or place we don't cover), describe it here in one sentence. We review these every week and build the most-requested data first.
